items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Ernie Lewis the pianist, I got him the job with Scobey.

ctx.x: Yeah, the traditional revival thing going on there.

And a lot of the tunes I knew from a kid, having heard all that stuff on records. And then of course when I got with Scobey why I learned all those tunes, they were a snap, the transition was a snap. So anyhow that was October. So then we came back to San Francisco and so that following May we got a call again. They wanted us for a month. And during that month there was a woman who lived in Chicago who was an ex-showgirl from Seattle and Ernie Lewis the pianist, I got him the job with Scobey. He knew her, so one…
That’s great. I’m going to pause for minute. We’re going to change tapes. If you don’t mind talking a little more.
